Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of BLK.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $7.39 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 155 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2022.
Our gross margin expanded by 155 basis points to 72.4%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 11% to 9% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. We generated $6.8 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 11% to 9% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
